summary: Tested the new two-step auth end to end: app account (email/password, Google button) plus a 6-digit staff PIN with account linking, along with admin 'Accesos y PIN' and the account-gated client flows. Backend: 42/42 pytest pass (16 new tests in test_account_auth.py, plus 26 in the updated regression file test_gmconecta_api.py). Frontend at 390x844: all requested flows pass. These are: opens on /login when signed out; register with validation errors; session survives reload; drawer account and sign-out; re-login; admin PIN, wrong-PIN error and the change-PIN form; Accesos screen with change-PIN and unlink sheets; 'Salir del modo' keeps you signed in; TR01 and FE01 PINs; the 4-step quote request prefills name and email from the account; Mis solicitudes lists the request; Contacto account-card and Cerrar sesión; Google button redirects through auth.emergentagent.com to accounts.google.com. Also checked: the staff mode survives a reload, and when the admin unlinks the profile the app drops back to Cliente while staying signed in. No functional bugs found. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: The global per-profile lockout key 'account:{role}:{code}' (15 failures, any IP, any account) lets anyone with a free self-registered account lock the admin, or any worker or store, out of PIN login for 15 minutes. It is a denial-of-service vector. Consider keying this limit per account_id + profile instead of globally.
'cuenta-total:{email}' (15 failures from any IP) lets a third party lock any user's email login for 15 minutes just by knowing the address. Same DoS concern.
No rate limit on registration, so anyone can create accounts in bulk (and each new account can then add attempts to the PIN lockout above).
Idempotency lookup returns an existing request by idempotency_key without checking cuenta_id. Low risk because the keys are random UUIDs.

action_items: Optional hardening: make the global PIN lockout key per-account (account_id + role + code) so registered strangers cannot lock out the admin PIN; do the same for the email-login total counter.
Optional: add per-IP rate limiting to /api/cuenta/registro.
Code size: admin_routes.py is 1130 lines (>700); consider splitting it (accesos, ferreterias, finanzas, obras).
critical_code_review_comments: Account and staff session design is solid. The staff JWT carries the account session sid, and resolve_token checks that the session exists and that user.account_id matches. So logging out or being unlinked ends the staff mode at once (verified by API and in the UI).

check_pin enforces exactly 6 digits, at least 3 distinct digits, no arithmetic sequences, a common-PIN list, and no repeated halves. It is applied in cambiar-pin, admin accesos, and admin create/patch of workers and stores (verified).
The X-Auth-Error header is set only for expired or invalid sessions, so a wrong password or PIN never signs the user out (verified: no header on /cuenta/login 401).
admin_routes.py is 1130 lines; it should be split.
